root_limits: No exact duplicate merges asserted; primary overlap pointers remain related navigation, not complete scientific identity. Three proposals are semantic and three methodological. Counterexample for103 concerns the ablation criterion only.

assessments.reason: A reading-marginalization policy is not a new manuscript semantic law. Competing uncertain transcriptions may legitimately imply different candidate propositions until the actual source reading is resolved. Specify a finite observable prediction beyond edition invariance before selecting a test.

Feature compatibility does not uniquely identify the same participant: a fresh participant with the same features satisfies the proposed positive result. Fix an independently distinguishing participant relation and explicit predictions of both full models.

The ablation requirement can reject a correctly identified intersection key. Let U={a,b,c}, constraint1={a,b}, constraint2={a,c}. Their intersection uniquely selects a, but removing either nonredundant constraint leaves two possibilities. Loss of unique identification after removal is not a falsification of the correct intersection. This is a design counterexample, not a manuscript test.

Distinct operations can agree on the observed input/output states. The named rival explicitly allows coincident contexts, so output preservation on another such context does not distinguish it. Specify a separating input or relation where the two complete operations predict different outcomes; no preknown word translation is required for joint inference.

Asserted versus conditional is a substantive semantic proposal, but no particular source construction and independently observable commitment contrast are nominated. Operation changes or layout alone do not fix commitment. Preserve the hypothesis untested.

A held reconstruction criterion can assess a proposed model, but source/target relations and the semantic representation remain unspecified. Reversibility by itself does not identify denotation. Nominate a finite independently observed relation with a real held recombination; do not count an analyst-state roundtrip as a translated clause.
